The proof is in `/work/fateh_011.lean`. It compiles with `lean` and produces no output at all: no errors, no warnings, and no "declaration uses `sorry`".

The imports, the theorem statement and its docstring are unchanged. Only the `sorry` line was replaced.

The argument:
- H has prime order 17, so it is cyclic.
- Conjugation gives a homomorphism φ : G → MulAut H.
- The image of φ has order dividing both 3825 (via the quotient G/ker φ) and |Aut H| = φ(17) = 16. Since gcd(3825, 16) = 1, the image is trivial.
- So every g commutes with every element of H, which puts H in the center.

I also created and then deleted two scratch files in `/work`. A backup of the original is at `/tmp/orig_011.lean`.
